workspaceIntro: A dedicated space for your research, shared goals, and interview results.
loginDescription: Bring prototype interviews together around one goal. Keep the details close and the findings in focus.
loginHint: Sign in with your IteroJM account.
haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
resetSent: Check your email for a password reset link.
confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
authError: We could not complete sign-in. Check your details and try again.
errorBody: We could not load this content. Please try again.
unavailableTitle: Research is not enabled here yet
unavailableBody: This preview is ready to connect when Research access is enabled for this environment.
accessTitle: Research access is not available for this account yet
accessBody: Your account is signed in. A Research invitation or access is needed before you can create a workspace.
configBody: The application needs its environment connection before sign-in is available.
conflictBody: Reload the latest version before editing again. Your changes remain visible below so you can copy them.
notFound: This item could not be found or you do not have access.
missingGoal: Add a shared goal to continue.
previewNote: Shared goals, research guides, recordings and summaries with evidence in one workspace.
studiesDescription: Test prototypes with users and identify what to improve. Bring interviews together around a shared goal, get a summary of each conversation, and combine findings with supporting evidence.
goalPlaceholder: What do we want to learn from every interview?
goalHint: Every interview in this study shares this starting point.
briefPlaceholder: What are we testing? Who is it for? Which scenarios and questions matter?
briefHint: Add context when it helps. You can start with a goal and return to the brief later.
emptyStudiesTitle: A clear goal. A place for every insight.
emptyStudiesBody: Create your first study for a product, feature, or change you want to test.
noBrief: No detailed brief yet. Your shared goal is enough to get started.
studyContextDescription: Use one goal and brief across the interviews in this study.
emptyInterviewsBody: Add an interview and its transcript. Every session belongs to this shared research goal.
synthesisPending: Cross-interview synthesis will be available when research analysis is enabled. Individual summaries remain the primary result.
briefAiPending: AI-assisted brief and interview-guide preparation is planned for a later release.
summaryEmptyBody: Add and save a transcript, then generate its summary using the shared study goal.
processingPending: Source versions are retained. You can assess how corrections affect the summary.
transcriptHint: The transcript is the source for analysis. Review or correct it here.
transcriptEmpty: No transcript yet. Add the conversation to preserve the source material.
speaker: Speaker
segmentPlaceholder: Paste or type this part of the conversation…
reviewNeededBody: The summary may need review after a transcript or study-context change. A changed version alone does not establish that the edit was meaningful.
studyChanged: This study has been updated. Existing summaries keep their original context until analysis is run again.
leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
jobQueued: Queued. You can leave this page; the result will be saved here.
jobRunning: Analysing the saved sources. You can return later.
jobFailed: Analysis could not finish. You can try again.
jobStale: The source changed during analysis. Run it again to use the latest version.
saveBeforeAnalysis: Save your changes before starting analysis.
analysisUnavailable: Analysis is not enabled in this environment yet.
synthesisDescription: Run synthesis when you want to compare current interview summaries. Review shared insights and disagreements, each linked to its sources.
synthesisEmpty: Generate at least one current interview summary, then compile the overall findings. If sources change, regenerate the findings.
noSourcesBody: Generate an interview summary using the current goal and transcript, then try again.
limitBody: This workspace has used its preview allowance. Additional capacity must be enabled before continuing.
planHint: Set shared questions, test tasks and success criteria before comparing interviews. You can start with a goal alone and refine the plan later.
plan_questions: What do we want to learn?
noTasks: No test tasks yet. Add tasks and success criteria to compare interview outcomes.
participantHint: Link repeat sessions using a participant. Without a link, results are counted by session.
preparationHint: AI uses the current saved goal, brief and plan to suggest clarifications, a revised brief or an interview guide. Review and accept any proposed changes before they become shared context.
preparationDescription: What are you testing and what do you want to learn?
impactHint: Compare the current transcript with the original summary source. The result is a recommendation; you choose when to regenerate.
CRITICAL_EDIT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Speaker, structure, negation or numbers changed; review the conclusions.
evidenceHint: A separate analysis covers all study tasks and cites evidence for comparing sessions.
resultsHint: Compare each session against the current task criteria. Full success is counted among observed attempts; unknown and unattempted tasks stay separate. Open a result to review its evidence or correct it.
resultCoverage: Sessions: {{sessions}} · Identified participants: {{linked_participants}} · Unlinked sessions: {{unlinked_sessions}} · Current summaries: {{current_summaries}}
selectEvidence: Select the segments supporting this outcome. The previous assessment is retained in history.
uploadHint: MP3, M4A, WAV, WebM or MP4: up to 100 MB and 2 hours. Interrupted uploads can be resumed. Once verified, recordings are processed in the background.
autoSummaryAfterUpload: Generate a summary using the current brief after transcription
inviteHint: Create a link for a specific email address and share it with your teammate.
inviteExpiryHint: This is the deadline to accept the invitation. It does not end membership after acceptance.
shareInviteHint: The link is shown only now. It can be used by the verified owner of the specified email address.
removeMemberConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the team? Their access and active jobs will be stopped.
error_RESEARCH_NO_TASKS: Add test tasks and success criteria to the study plan first.
error_RESEARCH_CONTEXT_CHANGED: The objective or criteria changed. Generate a new summary using the current plan.
error_RESEARCH_QUEUE_FULL: The processing queue is full. Try again shortly.
error_RESEARCH_REPORT_TOO_LARGE: Reports currently support up to 500 sessions. Split the study into separate comparisons.
error_RESEARCH_MEDIA_TOO_LARGE: Choose a recording up to 100 MB.
error_RESEARCH_INVALID_MEDIA: The audio track or duration could not be read. Check the format; recordings may be up to 2 hours.
error_UPLOAD_FAILED: The transfer was interrupted. Choose the same file and resume the upload.
error_UPLOAD_FILE_MISMATCH: Choose the same recording to resume, or cancel the previous upload.
copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the text and copy it manually.
addSourceFirst: Add and save a transcript, or upload a recording first.
newInterviewHint: Name this session. You can upload a recording or add the transcript on the next screen.
recordingFormats: Audio or video · up to 100 MB
resumeHint: An upload is unfinished. Choose the same file to resume where you left off.
noResultSessions: Add interviews and analyze their tasks to see a comparison.
searchHint: Try another title or clear your search.
noHistory: History will appear after the first save.
signupHint: One account for IteroJM and Research.
resetHint: We’ll send you a link to recover your account.
recoveryHint: Choose a new password for your account.
authError_reset: Could not send the link. Check the email address and try again.
authError_signup: Could not create your account. Check the fields, or sign in if you already have an account.
authError_recovery: Could not update the password. Try again or request a new recovery link.
demoAnalysis: AI is disabled in this demo. You can explore the prepared example findings.
demoRecording: Recording uploads will be available once test storage and processing are connected.
archiveStudyConfirm: Archive “{{title}}”? It will be removed from active studies.
archiveInterviewConfirm: Archive “{{title}}”? It will no longer be included in study results or synthesis.
jobCanceled: Analysis was canceled. You can run it again anytime.
pasteTranscriptHint: Paste text with timestamps, speaker lines, or plain paragraphs (for example, “00:12 Participant: I looked for the delivery date”). Each line or paragraph will become a segment.
pasteTranscriptPlaceholder:
00:05 Researcher: Show how you would choose delivery.
00:18 Participant: I see two options, but not the date.
duplicateStudyHint: Creates a new study with this goal, brief, and research plan (prototype, questions, hypotheses, tasks, and guide) without copying existing interviews.
